unit.why: A narrative told by R. Bertsi of Nadvorna about R. Shabbetai of Rashkov's soul after his death on a Friday, followed by a short homiletic tail on Sabbath customs.
unit.boundary_note: division ends with section-transition matter ('סליק אות כ ונתחיל אות ל... מענין לדון את חבירו לכף זכות') belonging to the next section

stories.start_quote: שמעתי שסיפר הה״צ רבי בערצי מנאדבורנא
stories.summary_en: R. Shabbetai of Rashkov died on a Friday; at evening a heavenly messenger led him to the palace where Sabbath is received above, but an old man at the gate told him he would not be admitted until morning, because his custom was not to put on a white shirt for Sabbath until morning; the story leads into teachings on prolonging the Sabbath and not wasting it.
